title: Iowa Army Ammunition Plant — emergency permit and supporting documents
summary: EPA public notice describing an emergency hazardous-waste storage and treatment permit for degraded lead azide. The page may be updated as legal and operational circumstances change; consult the source for current status.
notes: Primary source; not a claim about conditions at other facilities.

title: Emergency hazardous-waste permit for storage and treatment of lead azide (redacted PDF)
summary: Redacted EPA emergency permit for lead-azide storage and treatment; includes the agency's permit conditions and summary of alternatives discussed in supporting materials.

title: Army article on alternative primary explosives and earlier Iowa stockpile concerns
summary: Army reporting states a research initiative began in 2004 in response to concerns about an approximately 40-year-old deteriorating lead-azide stockpile at this facility. The article does not establish that the specific inventory was identical to material discussed in 2026.
notes: Historical context only; no causal conclusion about subsequent decisions.
